overview: Two 1938-39 lists index Japanese mail censorship cases in Taiwan, Harbin, Tianjin, Qingdao, Batavia, and Shanghai, recording American and Iranian complaints and referring researchers to the underlying telegrams, correspondence, and an opened envelope, ending with the Maritime Commission's dispute over detained trans-Pacific mail.

subfiles.title: List of papers on mail censorship in Taiwan and Harbin
subfiles.about: An administrative index identifies two 1938 communications concerning official scrutiny of foreigners’ mail in Taiwan and American official mail at Harbin.
subfiles.summary: Lists a 1938 Gauss telegram on censored foreigners' mail in Taiwan, and Lockhart's telegram on American mail at Harbin.

subfiles.title: List of papers on Japanese interference with international mail
subfiles.about: An administrative index summarizes 1938–1939 reports and protests concerning Japanese censorship or detention of American, Iranian, and trans-Pacific mail.
subfiles.summary: Lists Tianjin mail complaints with Japanese assurances, Grew's Iranian protest, a detained Qingdao letter, Batavia's envelope, and a Shanghai inquiry.

interest: Shows dispersed records on Japanese mail censorship across China, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia, plus a Shanghai mail-detention dispute.
